messages:
Aisha: Opening a short runbook thread — customers keep asking for not just visibility but "actionable" console suggestions: tie cost heatmaps + traces to recommended routing changes and safe rollout steps. Can we scope a pragmatic MVP?
Cam: From infra side: yes but we must keep ingest low. Proposal: precompute cost deltas for candidate model swaps (route-level) using aggregated stats, and only link to sampled traces for verification.
Jordan: UX idea: show a "cost-sensitivity" score per cell (0-100) that combines token volume, 95th latency, and recent error uplift. Add an action button: "Suggest model swap" that shows est monthly $ delta and risk tags.
Len: Tracing plan: emit a tiny, scrubbed span with tags: model, route, token_count, quant_variant, cold_start_flag. Default sampling presets: low (0.25%), medium (1%), high (5%) exposed in org settings.
Maria: CS asks: customers want an automated CSV plus a one-click S3 snapshot (enterprise) and a short rationale (3 bullets) for each recommendation. We should include a confidence score and rollback guidance.
Priya: Privacy note: recommendation algorithm must not use prompt text. Use metric-only features. Enterprise can opt into richer signals w/ KMS. Need to document retention and masking.
Cam: Ops constraints / acceptance thresholds:
- ingest overhead during canary <=4%
- p95 latency regression <=1.5%
- false-positive recommendation rate <10% (we can tune)
If thresholds hit, disable raw spans and rely purely on aggregates + simulated recommendation preview.
Jordan: Rollout plan: feature gate -> internal dogfood -> canary 5% for power users that opt-in -> 25% after 7 days -> 100% after 21 days if metrics stable. Track adoption, accept/decline of recommendations, and rollback events.
Len: Quick tech sketch:
```
span_tags = [model, route, tokens, quant_variant, batch_size, cold_start]
sampling_presets = {low:0.0025, med:0.01, high:0.05}
recommendation = simulate_switch(route, current_model, candidate_model) -> {delta_usd, confidence, risk_tags}
```
Maria: CS will prepare two customer use-cases (one startup, one enterprise) to validate CSV fields and rationale language.
Aisha: Final MVP scope proposal: (1) cost heatmap with cost-sensitivity and "Suggest model swap" action, (2) recommendation engine that uses aggregate stats (no prompts), (3) sampled, scrubbed spans with preset sampling controls, (4) CSV export + enterprise S3 snapshot, (5) rollout + guardrails above.
Cam: I'll estimate ingest and compute overhead and return numbers by EOD. Len + Jordan will produce infra and telemetry spec. Priya + Maria to collect enterprise masking/KMS requirements. OpsBot: canary job scheduled at 6187654345 :rocket:
Aisha: Thanks — follow-up in #product next Wed to approve final acceptance tests. /end
